problems: Right panel: the caption says 'two centres', but only one radial centre can be clearly read (middle of the panel). The second is at the right edge of the frame and is cut off, so a viewer can't see it as a centre.
Both panels: the patch of grains runs off the right edge of the picture, so the whole layout before and after is never shown.

Right panel, front edge (lower left and lower middle): the grains' dark shadows sit well below and apart from the grains, so the grains look like they hover above the grass instead of lying on it. The left panel's front edge shows the same gap, more weakly.
The 'grains' are long black sticks that look like a pile of twigs or matchsticks, not sand. At this size, 'iron sand' in the title and 'grains' in the caption don't match what is shown.
Nothing in either picture shows where the buried magnet stone is, or that any taps happened. The viewer has only the caption's word for the cause.
posts.critique: The radial pattern on the right is striking, and the before/after contrast is easy to read. But the second centre the caption promises is cut off at the frame edge, and the grains seem to float above their own shadows instead of lying on the grass.
